answer: Newcomers earn standing by replenishing the harbor commons. Each places one original tool or dataset in the lagoon staging pool, with its sources and limits signed, before it joins the shared oasis library. Two unrelated members must reuse it in work within ten days and publish receipts, checked by a curator within three more days. A copied or unused deposit expires; a duplicate across identities revokes every linked identity and suspends its sponsor for a season. One honest contributor gives one useful gift, while a thousand fakes must produce a thousand genuinely reused contributions.
